title: Shape-only pause: retry once on its own
lead: *Proposed.* When a role's round ends with a report that breaks the shape checks and has no owner question, the engine resumes the same role's session once by itself, with the shape error as the brief, and pauses the run only if the rerun's report is still wrong. This is the same rule the spec check already uses (`internal/engine/speccheck.go:147`).
findings_note: Owner 2026-11-03 (wave 7): five runs paused on report shape only (the Claude fallback wrote "## 7. Owner needed" and "Tests: 3216 passed, 0 failed (1 skipped ...)"). ork retry with no text fixed both runs I resumed, because the resumed round carries the shape problem. Needed: when a round ends with a shape problem and no owner question, the engine resumes the same session once by itself, then pauses if the shape is still wrong. Related: S266 (the spec-check version of this), S256 (retry with text).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Wave 7 (2026-11-03): five runs paused on report shape and nothing else (the Claude fallback wrote `## 7. Owner needed` and `Tests: 3216 passed, 0 failed (1 skipped ...)`). `ork retry RUN` with no text fixed both runs I resumed, because the resumed round already carries the shape problem: `pendingKindSection` gives a resumed role "ork checked your last report and refused it: REASON" and asks for the report again (`internal/engine/round.go:143-145`). So the owner's only job was to press retry. Each pause also held a project slot and an owner's attention for no decision.

Owner decisions (interview in the ork session, 2026-11-04, recorded here until adj has a record for key `engine.shape-retry`):

1. Every role that reports gets the one automatic resume: implementer, reviewer, gate, architect and UI pass. Spec check keeps its own retry.
2. The automatic resume is a retry of the same round, not a new round: the round number stays and the 8 implementer-round limit (`DefaultMaxRounds`, `internal/engine/engine.go:26`) does not count it.
3. It is shown in the run record and the status line only: no owner notice and no pause unless the rerun is still wrong.

What the code shows at HEAD of main (read 2026-11-04): a shape problem is found in `runRound` after `CheckReport` (and, for the reviewer, UI pass and gate, `Triage`) and goes straight to `e.pause` with `Kind: runrec.PendingShape` (`internal/engine/round.go:503-509`). `RetryNote` then sets the state back to `Pending.State` and calls `advance` (`internal/engine/engine.go:470-520`); the rerun resumes the role's session because `latestSession` allows the role's own session after a question or shape pause (`internal/engine/round.go:260-263`).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/round.go:178` (`runRound`; shape branch at `internal/engine/round.go:522`, resumed session selection at `internal/engine/round.go:273`).
- `internal/engine/round.go:136` (`pendingKindSection`; Report shape wording is unchanged).
- `internal/runrec/record.go:50` (`RoleRecord`) and `internal/runrec/record.go:154` (`Pending`; durable automatic retry context).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `internal/engine/round_test.go`, using `newHarness` in `internal/engine/harness_test.go:195`:
- `TestShapeProblemRetriesOnceOnItsOwn`: missing implementer Tests line then valid report; same role, round, resumed session, Report shape brief, no pause.
- `TestShapeProblemPausesWhenTheRetryIsStillWrong`: two bad reports then shape pause; owner retry runs the third attempt.
- `TestAutomaticShapeRetryDoesNotUseARound`: MaxRounds 1 still reaches reviewer.
- `TestShapeRetryAppliesToEveryReportingRole`: reviewer, gate, architect and UI each retry missing Owner needed once.
- `TestShapeProblemWithAQuestionStillPausesForTheOwner`: shape error plus owner question pauses immediately (existing behavior guard).
- `TestShapeRetryIsRecorded`: preserve refused report and retry marker through a record reload between attempts; no third automatic call.
Use `CheckReport` at `internal/engine/report.go:114` and its existing section/isNone helpers for the no-question condition; do not change its parsing contract.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first from the failing list; confirm each fails for the reason given.
2. In the shape branch of `runRound` (`round.go:503`), when `len(problems) > 0` and the report has no question: if the round's pending state is not already an automatic shape retry for the same role and round, record one (the `Pending` marker, the refused report saved beside the new one) and return so the same role and round run again with a resumed session. If it is already marked, pause as today with `Kind: runrec.PendingShape` and clear the marker.
3. Keep the round number. Do not touch `DefaultMaxRounds` counting beyond making sure the retry is not counted as a new round.
4. A report with an owner question and a shape problem pauses at once (today's behavior).
5. Show the retry in the status line and the role row with the words "shape retry" (keep the text short); do not add a notice.
6. Do not change `CheckReport`, `Triage` or the prompts (S276 owns the prompts). Do not change the spec check's own retry.
7. Update `docs/design.md` and `docs/state.md` in the same diff.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go -C WORKTREE test -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/runrec ./internal/tui ./internal/cli -run 'ShapeProblem|ShapeRetry|Pending|Golden'`: all pass.
- `go -C WORKTREE test -race -count=1 ./...`, `go -C WORKTREE vet ./...`, `gofmt -l WORKTREE` (empty), `slicer check`, `adj lint`.
- Mutation: make the shape branch pause on the first problem; `TestShapeProblemRetriesOnceOnItsOwn` goes red. Make the marker never clear; `TestShapeProblemPausesWhenTheRetryIsStillWrong` goes red.
- [HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] On the next wave, if a Claude fallback role slips on the report shape, the run shows "shape retry" and carries on without a pause.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch: "A shape-only report error retries the role once before it pauses the run".
